description: Generic, reusable, privacy-safe lessons distilled from the v1.5.0 release session. Copied to ~/.claude/lessons/ on install ONLY if the ledger is empty — never overwrites user lessons. No personal data, no secrets, no paths.

lessons.violation: Hook test scanned the real repository cwd
lessons.root_cause: Test pointed the gate at the live repo; CI-linux had different repo state than the dev machine
lessons.correction: Hook tests must point the gate at an empty temp cwd so repo files never enter the scan

lessons.violation: Local checks passed but hosted CI failed
lessons.root_cause: Local environment differs from CI (OS, repo state, path translation); local-only verification is insufficient
lessons.correction: Verify locally, then confirm on CI before declaring done; CI is the authority for release

lessons.violation: package.json version not bumped at release time
lessons.root_cause: No mechanical check tying package/controls/tag versions together
lessons.correction: A health check asserts package.json version == controls version before release

lessons.violation: E741 class: single-letter loop variable 'l' recurring across new code
lessons.root_cause: Ambiguous names are a blind spot that recurs once the pattern is used
lessons.correction: Use descriptive loop variables; verify-edit lint enforces it

lessons.violation: A scanner flagged its own pattern strings as defects
lessons.root_cause: Hooks scanned test/hook files containing literal pattern strings as fixtures
lessons.correction: Scanners skip test files and their own sources; shared scan.py skip_names
